description: Get a public PNG URL for a chart. Use it when the chart goes into an email, a Slack or chat message, a PDF or a Markdown document (as ![title](url)). The data travels in the URL: anyone with the URL can see the chart and its data, so for confidential data use render_chart.

config.description: A Chart.js v4 configuration as plain JSON (no functions), e.g. {"type":"bar","data":{"labels":[...],"datasets":[{"label":"...","data":[...]}]}}

name: chart_url
title: Chart image URL
